# B"H
<!-- Boruch Hashem -->
<!-- Blessed is He -->

# Phase Two: Improved Evidence Plan

> The Awtsmoos separates first light from garments rich and wide;
> Awtsmoos.com keeps every readiness promise truthful at its side.

## Proven Runtime Sequence

`index.html` loads `src/mitzvah-world.compact.js`.

The compact entry boots `MinimalSharedMeadowPage`, which launches `createMinimalMeadowRuntime`. That factory creates only the visible core, schedules bootstrap features after a bounded paint opportunity, and returns immediately. The readiness flow then passes a fabricated pending settlement while demanding the six fields installed only by the delayed scheduler.

## Improved Execution Path

1. Read `MinimalMeadowReadinessSettlement.js` and feature-receipt rules.
2. Read readiness and scheduler tests to preserve intended degraded behavior.
3. Trace all deferred module URLs in source and generated output.
4. Read chat optional-entry modules and their URL factories.
5. Read player hydration, model loader, and asset-path helpers.
6. Verify the canonical Chossid GLB on disk and through the public route.
7. Inspect CompactJS package scripts and transformation architecture.
8. Locate the exact game build command and generator configuration.
9. Inspect Git status and hashes before rewriting source.
10. Rewrite the readiness flow in full so bootstrap settlement precedes playable publication.
11. Rewrite only URL helpers or callers proven wrong in relocated compact context.
12. Add focused source and CompactJS regression tests.
13. Rebuild the compact bundle through the canonical generator.
14. Run syntax and focused unit tests before browser testing.
15. Serve or use the live route and capture console/network evidence.
16. Re-read every touched file and compare plan versus actual.
17. Update durable handoff and remaining-work files in full.

## Candidate Files, Not Yet Authorized for Editing

- `src/launcher/MinimalSharedMeadowReadinessFlow.js`
- its focused test file, once identified
- `src/app/DeferredAppModuleUrl.js` or specific deferred callers
- chat optional-entry modules, once identified
- player hydration or canonical asset URL helper, once identified
- CompactJS transformer/test files, only if generated relocation is faulty
- generated `src/mitzvah-world.compact.js`, only via canonical rebuild
- `NEXT_AI_README.md` and `REMAINING_WORK.md` after verification

## Verification Contract

- Bootstrap receipt resolves before essential readiness inspection.
- Rich hydration remains non-blocking and may degrade without killing play.
- Source and compact URL resolution produce the same canonical modules.
- No network path contains a cache hash as a directory segment.
- CompactJS rebuild is deterministic and its focused suite passes.
- Browser reaches `data-awtsmoos-runtime="playable"` without fatal errors.
